title: Everything Else
intro: Frequently asked questions and a few other parts of the club website.
faqTrialHeading: How do I try paddling with the club?
faqTrialAnswer: Open-night sessions run seasonally and need to be booked online. You do not need to be a member to attend, and your first three trial sessions are free. Check the [Beginners page](/beginners) for current details and booking information.
faqMembershipHeading: When do I need to become a member?
faqMembershipAnswer: Membership is required after your first three trial sessions. Current membership options and prices are listed on the [Membership and Events page](/membership); prices can change, so check the live listing.
faqWhatToBringHeading: What should I bring to a session?
faqWhatToBringAnswer: Bring a towel, clothes that can get wet, a warm change of clothes, and flat shoes that will stay on in the water. A wetsuit is optional. See the [Beginners page](/beginners) for current guidance.
faqChildrenAnswer: Young people under 16 must be supervised by an accompanying adult at club nights. Children under 8 may paddle in an open canoe with a supervising adult; children need to be at least 8 to join a kids class or paddle in a one-person boat. Check the [Beginners page](/beginners) before booking.
faqHireHeading: Can I hire a boat or equipment?
faqHireAnswer: Current boat and kit hire options, prices and terms are shown on the [Membership and Events page](/membership). If you need equipment for a single visit or are not yet a member, contact the club before booking to confirm what is available and who can use it.
faqTripsHeading: How do I find out about paddling trips?
faqTripsAnswer: White water trips are organised by request. See the [Disciplines page](/disciplines) for more information, check the [Membership and Events page](/membership) for current listings, or contact the club to ask about a trip.
faqExperiencedHeading: I have paddling experience. How do I join a session?
faqExperiencedAnswer: Contact the club through the [Contact Us page](/contact-us) and describe your experience, qualifications and the discipline you are interested in. A club lead can advise which session is appropriate and whether an introduction or skills check is needed.
faqSupportedHeading: Can the club support paddlers with additional access needs?
faqSupportedAnswer: Please contact our [Supported Paddling coordinator](mailto:supported.paddling@forthcanoeclub.co.uk) before visiting to discuss your needs and confirm current access arrangements. You can also read about the [Access Project](/access-project).
